name: Social Trends Connector
description: Read-only trend/analytics access to TikTok and Instagram, plus optional scheduling, via one of OmniSocials, Blotato, or Zernio. Pick one implementation at setup time.

capabilities.name: trends.search
capabilities.description: Search trending videos by platform, city/geo, and hashtag/cuisine tags.

capabilities.name: creators.lookup
capabilities.description: Fetch creator profile and engagement stats for a given handle.

capabilities.name: analytics.get
capabilities.description: Fetch post/video analytics (views, engagement rate, shares) for a date range.

capabilities.name: posts.schedule
capabilities.description: Schedule a post for publishing. GUARDED: only callable with a valid approval_token from skills/approval-gate.skill.json.

browser_takeover_fallback.notes: If the chosen provider does not support a needed read (e.g. a platform surface without a plugin), fall back to Grok Bot browser takeover using the owner's persisted TikTok/Instagram session.
